title.text: What if you couldn't sleep for 30 days?

lines.l_brain: Your body is exhausted. Your brain isn't.
lines.l_nod: Day 3. Your brain tries to sleep. Denied.
lines.l_class: Day 4. Everyone can sleep. Even the teacher.
lines.l_extra: Day 7. Extra hours. Time for everything.
lines.l_record: Day 19. Longer than anyone on record.
lines.l_see: Then your brain starts seeing things.
lines.l_toaster: Day 22. Simple things stop making sense.
lines.l_alone: Day 25. The whole world sleeps without you.
lines.l_beg: Day 28. Your body begs for rest.
